name: freshness-differences-precondition-labels-solo
body: The four early-return labels (`database`, `socket`, `git sha`, `recorded scan`) are each reported alone, so an early-return verdict never also lists the collected inputs. `database` and `git sha` are the remaining inputs' NotApplicable preconditions; `socket` is a differing input (an untrusted-DB phantom projection after an unclean session exit) and `recorded scan` is likewise a differing input (no usable `Scan` row) — both reach Stale while a HEAD sha is present. Upgrade by enumerating an early-return label in an e2e test only if that pairing becomes a contract.
